behavior: A stealthy pursuit hunter that waits within foliage or moves through dense cover, then bursts after small birds with swift, agile flight. It also pounces from low perches and typically crosses open areas with a flap-flap-glide pattern.
field_marks: Small head and compact, sharply hooked bill with a yellow cere
Short, rounded wings and a long, dark-banded tail that is usually square-tipped
Very thin yellow legs with slender toes
Adults slaty blue-gray above with narrow rusty red-orange barring below
Immatures brown above with coarse vertical brown streaks on white underparts
Bright yellow eyes in immatures, becoming redder with age
habitat: Breeds in dense forest, often where conifers are present, and also uses mixed or deciduous woodland. Outside the breeding season it frequents forest edges, thickets, brushy areas, and other wooded habitats; migrants may cross open country and follow ridges.
